title: PG&E Home Rebates 2026: EV Chargers, Free Upgrades and Electrification Help
desc: What PG&E pays homeowners in 2026: EV charging rebate up to 50% or $2,000, pre-owned EV up to $4,000, free upgrades for income-qualified homes. We found no PG&E heat pump rebate.
lead: PG&E has few cash rebates for home upgrades compared with the city utilities in California. Its biggest offers are for EV charging and for free upgrades to income-qualified households. This page lists what we verified on PG&E's own pages, and where other programs fill the gap.
cards_intro: We read PG&E's pages on October 2, 2026. Each card names the fact with the date and a source link. PG&E also lists a pre-owned EV rebate of up to $4,000 and a $300 generator and battery rebate on its rebates page, which we did not verify in detail.

cards.title: Residential EV charging rebate
cards.note: Standard option for PG&E-approved charging equipment. Rebate Plus, for households under 80% of area median or on a qualifying assistance program, pays up to $2,000 for a charger or up to $5,000 for a panel upgrade plus charger.

cards.title: Energy Savings Assistance
cards.note: Free upgrades such as heat pump water heaters, furnaces, lighting and refrigerators for income-qualified households. Income limits run from $39,900 for one person up to $82,500 for four, valid through May 31, 2027.

cards.title: Building electrification resources
cards.note: Low or no-cost electrification in targeted neighbourhoods through Empower My Home and Powerful Neighborhoods, by invitation or address, plus free HomeIntel energy tools.

cards.title: BayREN EASE Home
cards.note: For single-family homes built before 2010 with income at or under 120% of area median, for PG&E customers across nine Bay Area counties.

sections: Who PG&E serves, and community choice

PG&E delivers power across much of Northern and Central California. Many cities buy their electricity from a community choice provider such as CleanPowerSF, San Jose Clean Energy or Ava, but PG&E still delivers it. The EV rebate covers CCA customers too. Other rebates depend on your supplier, so check which company supplies the power on your bill.

We did not find a PG&E cash rebate for a heat pump, a heat pump water heater, insulation or a battery on the pages we read. PG&E's electrification page points to neighbourhood programs and free tools instead. If a quote claims a PG&E heat pump rebate, ask for the program page. For nearby cash incentives, look at your city or community choice provider, and see our pages for Fresno and Bakersfield.

PG&E's EV rebate is one per household, first come first served, and you must apply within a set period after buying the equipment. You need a battery or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle registered in California. The standard option covers up to half the price of PG&E-approved equipment. The Rebate Plus option is for lower-income households and can reach $2,000 for a charger or $5,000 for a panel and charger together.

Energy Savings Assistance is available to renters and homeowners in a house, mobile home or apartment at least five years old, if household income is at or below the limit or the household is in a qualifying program. It can include a heat pump water heater, which makes it the closest thing to a PG&E heat pump water heater rebate. State and federal money adds little in 2026. TECH Clean California lists its single-family funds as reserved, the federal home electrification rebates are on hold, and the federal 25C and 25D credits ended after December 31, 2025.
claim_steps: Confirm your power is delivered by PG&E.
Check your income against the Energy Savings Assistance table first.
For an EV charger, buy PG&E-approved equipment and apply within the allowed period.
Look at your community choice provider and city for other incentives.
Ask any contractor who quotes a PG&E rebate for the program page.
guides: PG&E rebate rejected: what to do
faq: Does PG&E pay a heat pump rebate?
We did not find one on the pages we read. Check your community choice provider and city for local incentives.
How much is the PG&E EV rebate?
Up to 50% of the price of approved equipment, or up to $2,000 for a charger under Rebate Plus for lower-income households.
Who qualifies for Energy Savings Assistance?
Renters and homeowners in homes at least five years old with income at or under the limit, or in a qualifying program.
Are community choice customers eligible for the EV rebate?
Yes. PG&E lists CCA customers as eligible.
Is free weatherization available in the Bay Area?
BayREN EASE Home pays 80% of weatherization costs for qualifying PG&E customers.
